units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 98:14">Gen. R. s. 98</cite> <he>הכל בק׳ יסורין בק׳ וכ׳</he> in every condition of life faith is a potent factor, sufferings are borne by faith, sanctification of the Name (martyrdom) rests on faith &c.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 736:1">Yalk. Ps. 736</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 40:2">Ps. XL, 2</cite>) <he>אם אין ביד ישראל אלא הק׳ כדאי הן לגאולה בשכר הק׳</he> if Israel possess no merit except faith, it is worthy of redemption as a reward for its faith; Midr. Till. to Ps. l. c. (corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 241:2">Yalk. Ex. 241</cite> (ref. to Ps. l. c.) <he>מתוך הק׳ ויט אלי וכ׳</he> out of this hope it came to pass that he inclined to me &c.; Tanḥ. ed. Bub., <cite ref="Exodus 12">B’shall. 12</cite>; <cite ref="Exodus 12">ib.</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 27:14">Ps. XXVII, 14</cite>) <he>אם בא קִוּוּיְךָ יפה וכ׳</he> (not <he>קויך</he>) if what thou hast hoped for, comes to pass, it is well; if not, hope again; a. e.
